hero.headline: Designing spaces that breathe.
hero.subheadline: We blend architectural precision with natural elegance.

intro.heading: Our approach
intro.text: We create environments grounded in stillness and light. Every material is chosen with intent. Every line serves a purpose.

servicesTeaser.heading: What we do
servicesTeaser.text: From concept to completion — every detail resolved.

whoWeAre.heading: Who we are
whoWeAre.text: We are a studio dedicated to the craft of living well. Our team shapes spaces that respond to human presence. We work across Bangalore · Trichy · Hyderabad · Coimbatore.

philosophy.heading: Our philosophy
philosophy.text: We believe in the weight of good materials and the warmth of natural light. True luxury is found in restraint. We listen to the architecture and let the space breathe.

process.title: We begin by listening.
process.description: We sit down to understand your rhythm. We explore how you move, rest, and gather in a space.

process.title: Concept and clarity.
process.description: We translate your vision into precise architectural gestures. Form and texture begin to take shape.

process.title: Refinement.
process.description: We layer light and shadow. Every detail is resolved to ensure the design feels effortless.

process.title: Realization.
process.description: We guide the execution with uncompromising care. We bring the vision into the physical world.

interiorDesign.heading: Interior design
interiorDesign.oneLiner: Custom space planning and aesthetic detailing for rooms and homes.
interiorDesign.description: We shape the interior atmosphere to suit your life. We consider the texture of the walls and the warmth of the floors. Every piece is placed to invite stillness.

exteriorDesign.heading: Exterior design
exteriorDesign.oneLiner: Elevation options, facade detailing, and color schemes before construction begins.
exteriorDesign.description: We define the boundary between your home and the world. We craft facades that hold weight and presence. Your home will stand in harmony with its surroundings.

archViz.heading: ArchViz
archViz.oneLiner: Photorealistic 3D visualizations — walk through your future space before it's built.
archViz.description: Experience the light and scale of your project early. We render atmosphere and depth with absolute precision. See the future of your space.

intro.heading: Let us talk
intro.text: We are ready to hear about your next project. Reach out to begin the conversation.

projectPlaceholder: Sunlight washes over brushed limestone floors, catching the texture of raw linen. The room feels expansive yet deeply rooted. A singular architectural beam draws the eye outward, blurring the edge between indoors and nature. Here, stillness is the ultimate luxury.
